title: wg: partial-02 editorial fixes (21 items)
description:
Editorial findings in draft-ietf-mls-partial (partial-02). Editors' copy mlswg/mls-partial at 7fef7c1.

1. L10 (front matter): This is a standards-track WG document but carries consensus: false. That produces the wrong "does not represent IETF consensus" boilerplate when published as an RFC. Fix: consensus: true
2. L53 (Abstract): The article "a" (line 52) is followed by the plural "costs". Fix: "which can incur significant communication and computational costs"
3. L76 (Introduction): "much significantly" stacks two intensifiers. Fix: "with significantly lower communication and"
4. L110 (Terminology): "co-path" here, but "copath" at line 310, in CopathHash/copath_hashes, and in RFC 9420. Fix: Change "co-path" to "copath".
5. L117 (Terminology): "does not download, validate, and maintain" literally means not doing all three. Line 74 uses "or". Fix: "does not download, validate, or maintain a copy of the"
6. L137 (Terminology): The structures use the MLS extensions to the presentation language (`optional<T>`, `<V>` vectors). Those are defined in RFC 9420 Section 2.1, not RFC 8446. Fix: "...using the TLS presentation syntax {{!RFC8446}} as extended in {{Section 2.1 of RFC9420}}."
7. L172 (Large Meetings / Webinars): "each others'" should be "each other's". Same in -02. ("such setting" on line 166 is fixed in PR #7.) Fix: "see each other's identities"
8. L208 (Protocol Overview): "just enough of information" is ungrammatical. Fix: "just enough information about the ratchet tree"
9. L210 (Protocol Overview): "DS" is used without being introduced. Line 86 says "MLS Delivery Service" but does not define the abbreviation. Fix: On line 86, write "MLS Delivery Service (DS)".
10. L259 (Protocol Overview): "a membership proofs": the article does not match the plural. Same in -02. Fix: "they are extended with a membership proof so that partial clients can"
11. L382 (Joining via Annotated Welcome): Misspelling of "recipient's". Same in -02. Fix: "recipient's"
12. L398 (Joining via Annotated Welcome): `group_info` is not an RFC 9420 field or type name. The object is the GroupInfo decrypted from `encrypted_group_info`, and line 396 already calls it the GroupInfo object. Same in -02. Fix: "The `signer` field of the GroupInfo MUST be equal to the `leaf_index` field of the `sender_membership_proof`."
13. L405 (Joining via Annotated Welcome): Duplicated "the the". Line 406 also reads "instead of found by searching the tree". Same in -02. Fix: "The `my_leaf` value is taken from the `leaf_index` field of the `joiner_membership_proof`, instead of being found by searching the tree."
14. L486 (Annotated Commit): The sub-bullets under step 3 are indented 2 spaces, but the list item "3. " needs 3, so they do not nest. Published -02 renders them as a top-level list after step 3, so it is unclear that they are the modifications to the Section 12.4.2 processing. Fix: Indent lines 486-534, including the nested bullets, by one more space to match the step-2 list at lines 396-406.
15. L573 (Operational Considerations): "RFC MLS" is used as an informal name for RFC 9420 here and at lines 654 and 880. SplitCommit is named three different ways. Fix: Use "RFC 9420" / {{RFC9420}} in prose and in the table header, and pick one name for SplitCommit.
16. L602 (Security Considerations): The Group Key Secrecy bullet introduces the TreeKEM Tree Invariants, but the two invariants are listed as sibling bullets, so they read as more MLS guarantees. They also lack terminal periods. Line 583 says "the following ... as follows", which is redundant. Fix: Move "To obtain these properties ... Tree Invariants:" into its own paragraph after the guarantees list, and list the invariants separately with periods. Drop "as follows" on line 583.
17. L617 (Security Considerations): "two verification tools ProVerif and F*" lacks appositive commas. The analysis and models it relies on are not cited. Fix: "using two verification tools, ProVerif and F*," and add informative references to the published models or analysis.
18. L655 (Security Considerations): Plural subject "The exact security implications" with singular "is". Fix: "...of removing this uniqueness check are not clear but are not expected to be significant."
19. L657 (Security Considerations): Misspelling of "uniqueness". Same in -02. Fix: "uniqueness"
20. L862 (Known Issues): Wrong preposition: "discussed on {{operational-considerations}}". Fix: "discussed in {{operational-considerations}}"
21. L885 (Acknowledgments): Leftover placeholder, also in -02. Fix: Write the acknowledgments or remove the section.

From MLS audit workflow wf_581e61f8-b25 (2026-10-21), verified per item. Not yet reviewed by Mark; nothing posted upstream.
